subject: Lighting and power for productive work
hook: One small hole that tidies an entire desk.
ig:
One small hole that tidies an entire desk. That's the grommet, and where it goes matters more than people think.

Put it in the wrong place and you're stretching leads across the worktop anyway. Put it in the right place and the desk looks clear from the moment you sit down.

What we look at when placing one:

Where the monitor stand sits, because that's where most leads start.
Which side you plug your laptop in.
How far the nearest socket is, so the hidden route behind the side panel is as short as possible.
Whether you need a second grommet for a lamp or a phone charger.

Underneath, a cable tray holds the extension lead and power bricks off the floor, so the vacuum doesn't catch them and your feet don't either.

Small detail, big difference to working in that room every day. Which detail matters most at your desk? Tell us in the comments, and find our home office furniture via the link in bio.
fb:
This little round cover is one of the most useful things you can put in a desk.

It's called a grommet. Placed where your monitor and laptop sit, it lets every lead drop straight through the worktop. Underneath, a cable tray keeps the extension lead and adaptors off the floor, and the cables run behind a side panel to the socket.

We plan the position at the design stage and drill it in the workshop, so it lines up with how you actually work.
